15: def render_object_detail(context, obj, groups=None, property_display=None, layout=None):
16:     """Render all property groups for an object.
17: 
18:     ``groups`` can be pre-resolved ``ResolvedGroup`` instances (from the mixin)
19:     or a raw ``property_display`` list that will be parsed and resolved here.
20: 
21:     ``layout`` optionally overrides the layout pack (e.g. "accordion") for this
22:     render only; it defaults to ``crud_views_object_detail_settings.template_pack_layout``
23:     and is threaded down into the pack's own templates so nested ``render_group`` /
24:     ``render_property`` calls use the same pack.
25:     """
26:     if groups is None and property_display is not None:
27:         configs = parse_property_display(property_display)
28:         view = context.get("view")
29:         groups = resolve_all(obj, configs, view=view)

31:     pack = layout or crud_views_object_detail_settings.template_pack_layout
32:     tpl = select_template(
33:         [
34:             f"crud_views_object_detail/layouts/{pack}/object_detail.html",
35:             "crud_views_object_detail/object_detail.html",
36:         ]
37:     )
38:     return mark_safe(tpl.render({"groups": groups or [], "layout": pack}, context.get("request")))
